name: RIVER NEAR NEWTA DAM, JAIPUR, RAJASTHAN
coord_source_and_notes: UNRESOLVED, not plotted. WQMN_list.pdf PDF p.103 prints 26.919491, 75.930328, which is 0.37 km from 4781 Kanota and 0.78 km from the NRLD 2019 Kanota dam point, east of the city on the Dhund. The RSPCB/MNIT action plan (Dec 2018, Fig. 2.10, PDF p.19) maps Nevta dam near Muhana, south-west of the city, fed from the Dravyavati by a diversion channel from Gular dam (PDF p.42). Nevta is not in NRLD 2019 and no official coordinate for it was found. Where 2952 is sampled is a question for RSPCB/CPCB.
